=== S2 brainy-cooked-hog CLOSED — RP-02 SLICE 2 COMPLETE AND LANDED ===
Landed (each LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, submitted individually): 9371328844 Extract binding identity transitions (T1, Gerrit 1892); 250cac4d8c Extract absence, tombstone and comment policy (T2, Gerrit 1896 PS2); 9c3db3ea12 Add the narrow rich-emission facade operation (T3, Gerrit 1899 PS2). S2 close needed a fresh review-plan first (stale-pin-drift from children's material moving) and then passed.
CURRENT CODE STATE on origin/main 9c3db3ea12: binding_store.py 561 (was 799 at epic start), binding_lifecycle.py 533, binding_repository.py 360, run_differs.py 739 (61 lines of headroom - still the S3 T2 constraint). All three owners now exist behind one unchanged facade.
=== EXACT RESUME POINT: S3 convergent-pinelike-lunamoth (486a-69ef-6370-48ff) ===
rebar ready --epic 5e64 now returns ONLY 486a, so S3 is unblocked. It is UNSIGNED, as are all three of its tasks. Sequence: set file_impact FIRST then review-plan 486a (the ordering that avoided self-inflicted staleness in S2), claim, then T1 polarized-servile-jenny (c4f7, classify + complete interrupted retirements) -> T2 flamboyant-possessive-blackbuck (90a5, invoke recovery at the validated write boundary) -> T3 likeminded-wearproof-barracuda (ef69, cut rich-emission to the facade + finalize ADR 0099). Then the epic, whose close requires the residual-gap sweep.
S3 IS THE ONLY SLICE WITH GENUINELY NEW BEHAVIOR - the first two were pure extractions. So RED-first applies properly here rather than characterization: interrupted-retirement completion is new, and 'safety-abort' is the term this epic RESERVED for it (I corrected S2's plan and leaf to stop misusing it). The exact-match rule is that a live forward/reverse pair is removed only when tombstone, forward AND reverse identities all agree; repeat is a no-op; any mismatch, corrupt live file or replace failure safety-aborts retaining evidence.
BINDING CONSTRAINTS, all verified:
1. S3 T2's run_differs.py edit is the INVOCATION ONLY (739/800). Classifier lives in binding_recovery.py. Recovery runs after config snapshot, preflight, exclusive ownership and under-lock staleness validation, but BEFORE any remote fetch/walk/differ/mutation; construction, load, check, dry-run, preview, selection and filtered paths must perform ZERO recovery writes.
2. S3 T3 keeps its diff tight to _observe_rich_reemit (apply_handlers.py ~258-270) plus its docstring; do NOT reflow the adjacent _rich_cutover_active. The docstring at ~250-256 claiming binding_store.py 'cannot carry a narrower accessor' is NOW FALSE - S2 T3 added note_rich_emit - so update it in the same change as a direct non-behavioral fix. RP-04 S3 (6e3b) is closed, so the rebase precondition holds. The narrow op is BindingStore.note_rich_emit(local_id, wire) returning the count or None for a missing binding, and it does NOT save.
3. Any edit to a module containing a non-literal env read requires scripts/gen_env_registry.py before pushing - this bit twice (a one-line docs/env-vars.md shift each time). binding_lifecycle.py:70 is the current reference.
4. make lint does NOT cover every Verified gate. Also run scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py AND tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py (a SHA in a source comment fails the build - cite ticket ids, which matters because this epic characterizes pre-extraction behavior), plus make config-check and scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py. Scope regression runs wider than tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ - repo-wide guards live outside the subsystem tree.
5. Amend with --amend -F only when the message file carries the existing Change-Id forward, or Gerrit opens a duplicate change.
6. Close descriptions: tick AC boxes ONLY. Any text edit stales the attestation; box state is normalized out of the fingerprint.
7. After Submit, WAIT for mirror replication and confirm the artifact with git cat-file -e HEAD:<path> before a close that verifies it - a premature reset made S1's close fail on a missing ADR.
8. Surface-parity census is now scored by the code-review overlay: enumerate CLI / MCP-or-API / library facade / automated callers / dual-direction and mark each in-scope-and-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason, in the commit message. rebar review-code cannot preview locally (verify.enable_code_review is off in this checkout).
RESIDUAL GAPS FILED SO FAR (3): smalltime-rapid-elk (alerts never dedupe - records omit timestamp_ns), best-kingly-monkey (retarget RP-04 S7.3.a config reads to binding_lifecycle.py - now MORE urgent since S7.3.a is in_progress and landing in sub-parts), captious-hennish-mangabey (idempotency oracle no longer reaches moved clock reads). ADVISORIES ACCEPTED: P6 ac-quality on S1T2/S1T3/S2/S2T1/S2T2/S2T3, G6 0.298 on S1T3, P5 0.40 on S2, and S1T2's G1G2 (self-resolved when T1 landed).
FOUR FALSE DOCUMENTED CLAIMS FOUND AND CORRECTED, the epic's most transferable finding: (1) 'safety-abort on ambiguous double bind' - bind_confirm is last-writer-wins with no abort anywhere; (2) alert dedup - is_deduped compares timestamp_ns which no caller stamps, so it never fires; (3) comment map 'a key is never remapped' - the gate is equality-only so a differing id overwrites; (4) rich-emission 'save/dirty-gating' - the caller never saves per emit and save() is unconditional. Each was caught by writing the test the docstring implied and watching it fail against faithful code. Three MUTATION-FOUND oracle gaps were also closed (facade copying the repo document so a top-level insert is lost; a rebind fixture that could not tell a targeted pop from a sweep; a save spy watching only the facade while the owner holds the repository).
WORKTREE /Users/joeoakhart/impl-rp02-binding-store clean at origin/main 9c3db3ea12. Held-out oracles, mutation harnesses and /tmp/rp02-heldout/gate.sh <change> preserved.
